message.content: In one of LiHua's memorable matches in "Call of Duty: Warzone," the duo managed to turn a difficult situation around and secure a victory at the very last moment. Specifically, LiHua mentioned a match where they were down to just two players, and they successfully outsmarted the last remaining team. The excitement of the match was described as reaching a peak when they managed to snatch the victory at the last second. This moment exemplified the thrilling and strategic nature of the game, which LiHua particularly enjoyed due to the adrenaline rush it generated.
